name: @mnemosyne-plugins/artisan-studio
description: Stage your own pieces in rooms generated for you, in three beats: the place, the piece, the life around it. For any craftsperson: ceramics, lighting, woodwork, jewellery. Your files, on your machine.

descriptionI18n.en: Stage your own pieces in rooms generated for you, in three beats: the place, the piece, the life around it. For any craftsperson: ceramics, lighting, woodwork, jewellery. Your files, on your machine.
descriptionI18n.fr: Mettez en scène vos propres pièces dans des intérieurs générés pour vous, en trois temps : le lieu, la pièce, la vie autour. Pour tous les artisans : céramique, luminaires, bois, bijoux. Vos fichiers, sur votre machine.
descriptionI18n.es: Pon en escena tus propias piezas en interiores generados para ti, en tres tiempos: el lugar, la pieza, la vida alrededor. Para cualquier artesano: cerámica, iluminación, madera, joyería. Tus archivos, en tu equipo.

agentGuide: Name a piece or a scene the way the person says it (« vase bleu », « vase bleu salon »): the studio finds it by its words. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
To look at something: showTab for a screen, showScene for a scene full screen, showPiece for a piece, previewSite for the site as published, closeView to close.
A change of price, name or « sold »: editPiece. Her name, her texts, her e-mail: setBrand. Quality and picture shape: setSettings.

A new scene asked without its piece or its place (« crée une nouvelle scène dans le jardin »): newScene opens the studio's form with what was said and she finishes it. Never invent the piece or the place.

A scene whose piece and place were both said: createScene, then makeScene (spends credits, about 0.18 $ a picture, three pictures). One scene is made at a time (BUSY). It answers started: follow with scenes.
cutoutPieces takes the backgrounds off on this computer, free; the first one takes minutes.
setMotion living cuts the scene into layers (free): the scene then opens directly on its animation.
validateScene puts a scene on the site, publishSite publishes it. Look at the pictures before calling them good: the piece's fidelity is seen, not measured.

agentActions.summary: List the pieces: id, name, series or unique, price, status, whether it has a photo, and whether its background is on or off.
agentActions.details: cutting says a background is being taken off (true) or waiting (queued); cutoutError is the last refusal for that piece.

agentActions.summary: Take the background off the pieces' photos, on this computer and for free: the piece cut out becomes the photo on show.
agentActions.details: Runs one piece after the other and answers « started » at once (the first one can take minutes while the engine prepares). Follow it with pieces. A piece already cut out is skipped; an earlier cut-out of her own photo is reused. The photo before stays in the piece's versions.

pieceIds.description: The pieces, by name or id. Absent = every piece with a photo.

agentActions.summary: List the scenes: their piece, place, which pictures are made or missing, on the site or not, how they move, and what is being made now.
agentActions.details: making / clipping / layering say a job is running; error is the last refusal (an i18n code). Call it to follow makeScene, makeClip and setMotion.

agentActions.summary: Create a scene for a piece: the place it is shown in and what brings it to life. No picture is made yet.
agentActions.details: universe is the room ("Salon"), variant a spot in it ("Console"). Make its pictures with makeScene.

pieceId.description: The piece: its name as the person says it (« vase bleu ») or its id.

animation.description: What moves in the third picture (a plant, a light).

agentActions.summary: Open the studio's « new scene » form, as its button does, with the piece and the room already said. She chooses the rest on screen. Nothing is made or spent.
agentActions.details: For a scene asked without its piece or its place. A piece named and not found, or without a photo, leaves the choice of the piece to her. Answers what the orb says next.

piece.description: The piece, if the person named it: its name as she says it (« vase bleu ») or its id.

universe.description: The room or place, if the person said it (« Jardin »).

agentActions.summary: Make the missing pictures of a scene (up to 3), as the studio’s « Faire » button does.
agentActions.details: Spends credits: one generated picture per missing step. One scene at a time: refused BUSY while another scene is being made. Answers « started »; follow it with scenes.

sceneId.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.

agentActions.summary: Put a scene on the website, or take it off (online: false).
agentActions.details: Only a scene with its three pictures goes on. Publishing the site itself is publishSite.

sceneId.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.

online.description: true puts it on the site (default), false takes it off.

agentActions.summary: Choose how a scene moves on the site: images, living (the layers, free), or video (its clip).
agentActions.details: living makes the layers on this machine when they are missing (a few seconds to a minute).

sceneId.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.

agentActions.summary: Make the clip of a scene, from its second picture to its third.
agentActions.details: Spends credits (a short video). Answers « started »; the clip takes a few minutes, follow it with scenes.

sceneId.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.

note.description: A word on how it should move.

agentActions.summary: Add a page to the website: scenes, blog, catalogue, text or form.
agentActions.details: text, for a text or form page, is its words in Markdown. The studio opens the new page.

text.description: A text or form page: its words, in Markdown.

agentActions.summary: Export the website and put it online, as the site bar’s « Publish » does.
agentActions.details: Answers « started »; follow it with siteStatus. The site must have been set up once by the person (its host and token).

agentActions.summary: Where the website stands: what is running, whether the site online is up to date (stage), the last publication and its address, the pages, how many scenes are on it.
Show one of the studio's screens, as a click on its menu does.
agentActions.details: pieces (the creations), scenes, blog, about, contact, film, logo, site, hosting, costs, settings, or the name of a page she added. Closes what was open over the screen.

tab.description: The screen: pieces, scenes, blog, about, contact, film, logo, site, hosting, costs, settings, or an added page's name.

agentActions.summary: Show a scene full screen, as a click on its picture does.
agentActions.details: Opens on its last picture made, or on the beat asked: place (the room alone), piece (the piece in it), alive (with what moves).

scene.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.

beat.description: place, piece or alive. Absent = its last picture.

agentActions.summary: Show a piece full screen: its photos and its scenes over time.

piece.description: The piece: its name as the person says it (« vase bleu ») or its id.

agentActions.summary: Close what is open over the studio: a scene or a piece full screen, the site preview, a wizard or a dialog.
Show the site as it would be published, inside the studio or in its own window. Nothing is published.

window.description: true opens it in its own window.

agentActions.summary: Change a piece: its name, its description, its price, or whether it is available, reserved or sold.

piece.description: The piece: its name as the person says it (« vase bleu ») or its id.

price.description: Its price, in the site's currency.

agentActions.summary: Change what the site says about the person: her name, her tagline, her About text, her e-mail, her Instagram, the home page sentence, the note beside the contact form.
agentActions.details: Only the fields given change. Saved at once.

introLine.description: The sentence beside the film on the home page.

contactNote.description: The note beside the contact form.

agentActions.summary: Change the studio's settings: picture quality, picture shape, showing what each picture costs, the advanced tools.
agentActions.details: quality is « quality » (the better model, dearer) or « fast ». Only the fields given change.

agentActions.summary: Move a scene to another room (its universe), as a drag to another group does.

scene.description: The scene: its piece's name, with the room or the spot when the piece has several scenes (« vase bleu salon »), or its id.
